description: Source code for a custom media route provider in an Android application, implementing media control and route management.

classes.name: SampleMediaRouteProvider
classes.description: Custom media route provider for managing media routes and control requests.

classes.name: SampleRouteController
classes.description: Inner class handling route control actions, session management, and media playback.

methods.name: publishRoutes
methods.description: Creates and publishes media route descriptors with different volume handling configurations.

methods.name: onCreateRouteController
methods.description: Creates a new route controller instance for a given route ID.

methods.name: setVolumeInternal
methods.description: Sets the volume level and updates the route descriptors.

methods.description: Handles play control requests, managing session state.

methods.name: handleEnqueue
methods.description: Handles enqueue requests for media items.

methods.name: handleRemove
methods.description: Handles removal of media items from the session.

methods.name: handleSeek
methods.description: Handles seek requests to change playback position.

methods.name: handleGetStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of a media item.
